passage.label: To: All Staff / From: Human Resources / Subject: Parking Changes
passage.text:
Dear colleagues,

Starting next Monday, the east parking lot will be closed for repairs. The work [1] about three weeks. During this time, employees are asked to park in the north lot, which has [2] spaces than usual because of the construction. [3], we encourage everyone to carpool or use public transportation whenever possible. Shuttle buses will run between the train station and the main entrance every fifteen minutes. [4]

Thank you for your cooperation.

Human Resources

questions.exp: 来週月曜から始まる工事なので、未来を表す will take が入る。
後ろの spaces は数えられる名詞の複数形で、than があるので比較級の fewer。less は数えられない名詞に使う。
駐車場が減るという前の内容を受けて、「そのため」相乗りや公共交通を勧めている。Therefore が自然。

choices: A schedule will be posted on the staff website.
The new building will open in July.
Please submit your parking applications by Friday.
questions.exp: シャトルバスの話の次に、時刻表を掲示するという案内が自然につながる。他は話題が合わない。

passage.label: Notice to Members — Riverside Fitness Center
passage.text:
We are pleased to announce that Riverside Fitness Center will [1] a new swimming pool on the second floor this fall. The pool will be open to all members at no extra charge. [2] In addition, we will be offering free swimming lessons for beginners every Saturday morning. Space in these classes is [3], so we recommend that you sign up early. [4], you may do so at the front desk or on our website.

We look forward to seeing you at the pool!

questions.exp: will に続くので、動詞の原形 open が入る。open a new pool「新しいプールを開設する」。

choices: Membership fees will remain the same.
The first floor is under repair.
Our instructors are looking for a job.
The gym will close at nine o'clock.
questions.exp: 「追加料金なし」の話につながるのは、会費は変わらないという内容。
be 動詞の後ろの補語。「定員が限られている」の意味になる形容詞(過去分詞)の limited。
「申し込むには、受付またはウェブサイトでできる」。目的を表す不定詞 To register が入る。
